concept.material: brushed gunmetal and aged copper rivets
concept.internal_detail: intricate brass differential gears and micro-springs
concept.button: a small brass push-pin set flush into the end cap
concept.shell_mechanic: The ribbed tubular housing splits cleanly along its dorsal seam and hinges outward like twin metal wings
concept.emerging_parts: Six long jointed legs, a pair of gossamer wire-mesh wings, and a segmented thorax
concept.signature_move: its jointed metal stinger swivels upward once on its base pivot and its metallic antennae twitch forward together
